name: Poor
overview: Scripture emphasizes compassionate and just treatment toward the poor, forbidding charging interest on loans to them and requiring the timely return of their pledged garments, which are essential for their daily protection (Exodus 22:25-27). It also commands fairness in legal matters, instructing not to show partiality or distort justice in cases involving the poor (Exodus 23:3, 6). Additionally, provisions such as the Sabbath year rest for the land are instituted so that the poor may have sustenance, reflecting God's gracious care and the community's responsibility to support those in need (Exodus 23:11).
